translations.web: Behold, you desire truth in the inward parts. You teach me wisdom in the inmost place.
translations.bsb: Surely You desire truth in the inmost being; You teach me wisdom in the inmost place.
translations.kjv: Behold, thou desirest truth in the inward parts: and in the hidden part thou shalt make me to know wisdom.
translations.asv: Behold, thou desirest truth in the inward parts; And in the hidden part thou wilt make me to know wisdom.
